pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal brown regions with smooth-to-moderate edge gradients. Patches on the mid-flank occupy a significantly higher spatial area than those on the posterior flank and hindquarters, where patch size decreases and frequency increases.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored negative space network. Junction nodes are primarily Y-shaped triradiate intersections. Pathway pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the torso but exhibits narrowing in the posterior limb transition zones.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the dorsal neck line, presenting as a dark, textured linear edge against the background.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A localized, dark, circular area of textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation is visible on the upper mid-flank near the transition to the dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several high-luminance white pixel clusters are visible on the posterior flank and rump, suggesting parasitic attachment or localized skin disruptions.
other_distinctive_markers: Two avian organisms (oxpeckers) are perched on the lateral shoulder/lower-neck region.
